_readme: Seat/subscription pricing for the vendors and coding tools in data/models.json. Refreshed manually — see scripts/refresh-plans.md. Every price is read from the vendor's own pricing page (rendered in a real browser where the page is JS-only), or, when that page lists a tier without printing its number, from the vendor's help center / docs, or from the vendor's launch announcement as reported by the press — `billing` says which. A null price means the plan has no public list price (contact sales) — never a guess. Validated by scripts/validate-data.mjs.
